collect.says: Fom na wannan kundi, a kan intanet, wanda duk wanda ke da hanyar haɗinsa zai iya cikewa. Kowace amsa tana zuwa nan a matsayin layi.
collect.asks: Abin da fom ɗin yake tambaya
collect.hint: Fili ɗaya ga kowane ginshiƙi da aka yi wa alama. Sauran naka ne kaɗai.
collect.unsent: Ba a iya aikawa ba. A sake gwadawa.
collect.sealed: Ana rufe amsa a cikin burauzar baƙon, don haka mai masaukin ba zai iya karanta ta ba.
collect.online: Saka fom ɗin a kan intanet
collect.port: Fom na shafi zai iya cike {columns}.
